page.overview:
Who is Abraham Klein?

Abraham helped Iron Man seal the Controller in plastic after initial doubts, but when Iron Man explained the Controller's crimes, Abraham participated willingly, as they reminded Abraham of his father who had died in a Nazi concentration camp. Abraham investigated into a supposedly stolen patent for a rocket pack that Tony had designed, but a competitor company already held a patent. Abraham was kidnapped along with Tony's secretary Krissy Longfellow by Commander Kraken.

Mordecai Midas blackmailed Abraham to betray Stark, suggesting that Abraham knew the whereabouts of Klein's wife and daughter, whom he had not seen since 1939, when the Nazis invaded Poland and took Abraham to a camp. Midas ordered Abraham to look for a job at Stark's. Abraham intended to help Midas in his attempt to take over Stark International, because Abraham had faith in Anthony Stark: Abraham believed that Stark would stop Midas and then force Midas to reveal the information.

However, Tony and his bodyguard Iron Man (secretly Tony himself) failed to stop Midas. Once Midas had ensured his victory, he revealed Klein that Midas never had more information on Klein's family but the photographs.

Later, when Iron Man struck back at Midas, Abraham, who had no super human powers or equipment, physically attacked Midas with a bar. Midas punched Abraham with super human strength due to his exoskeleton. Abraham was fatally hurt and he died soon afterward, but Abraham lived long enough to see Midas defeated and to beg for forgiveness with his last breath.
